propositions: _build_jira_backend constructs AcliClient without validating that JIRA_URL, JIRA_USER, and JIRA_API_TOKEN are present and non-empty, allowing unconfigured Cloud environments to build a backend that fails only on the first API call with anonymous credentials
The Cloud adapter lacks parity with the DC adapter, which validates JIRA_PAT presence at construction time and raises BackendEnvError before building the transport
JIRA_USER in Cloud environments must be an Atlassian account email address; a bare handle or accountId silently causes 401 errors, but this format requirement is not validated at construction

The existing test test_cloud_build_backend_with_missing_credentials_does_not_fail_loudly documents and pins the silent-build behavior, creating a test-parity gap with DC's test_dc_pat_required_heldout.py

_build_jira_backend must be updated to validate credential presence (rejecting empty and whitespace-only values) and JIRA_USER email format before AcliClient construction, mirroring DC's fail-fast pattern
